Home.title: SACCO Platform
Home.eyebrow: Built for SACCOs in Kenya & Tanzania
Home.heroTitle: The operating system for your SACCO.
Home.heroSubtitle: Savings, shares, and loans - every transaction backed by a balanced, audit-ready ledger. Members serve themselves. Staff stay in control.
Home.heroImageAlt: A SACCO staff dashboard showing member totals, savings balances and ledger status
Home.sectionTitle: One system, from the teller window to the AGM.
Home.savingsBody: Mandatory, voluntary, fixed-term, goal, and junior accounts - each tracked separately from share capital, exactly as your bylaws and regulator expect. Withdrawals move through the same balanced ledger as everything else.
Home.savingsImageAlt: A hand holding a glass jar labelled Savings, filled with coins
Home.savingsBullet2: Share capital tracked apart from deposits
Home.savingsBullet3: Every withdrawal posts through the ledger
Home.loansTitle: Loans that grow with your members.
Home.loansBody: Members apply and guarantors pledge and consent from their own phones. Every application moves through appraisal to decision with a full paper trail - before a shilling ever moves.
Home.loansImageAlt: Coins in a glass with a small plant sprouting from them
Home.loansBullet3: Borrow up to a configurable multiple of deposits
Home.accountingBody: Every deposit, withdrawal and disbursement posts as a balanced double-entry journal entry. Nothing is ever edited or deleted, only reversed. Your trial balance is one click away, and it always balances.
Home.accountingImageAlt: A calculator resting on handwritten ledger sheets
Home.reportsBody: Live dashboards for staff, real-time statements for members. No more waiting for month-end to know where you stand.
Home.reportsImageAlt: A hand reviewing a bar chart on a tablet
Home.reportsBullet3: No month-end wait to know where you stand
Home.complianceTitle: Built for regulators, not just spreadsheets.
Home.complianceBody: ID formats, loan multipliers and withholding tax rates are configuration, not code - set once per country, correct for Kenya and Tanzania from day one, and ready for wherever you operate next.
Home.complianceImageAlt: Tax withholding forms next to a calculator and coffee
Home.anywhereBody: A self-service portal lets members check balances, apply for loans and respond to guarantee requests without calling the office. Staff keep full control with role-based permissions.
Home.anywhereImageAlt: A calculator app open on a phone resting on printed charts
Home.craftTitle: Built around how SACCOs actually work.
Home.craftBody: Bilingual in English and Kiswahili from day one, with every screen shaped around real teller, loan officer and member workflows - not retrofitted from a generic template.
Home.craftImageAlt: A hand pinning app screen mockups to a wall, connected with string
Home.ctaTitle: Ready to run your SACCO on solid ground?
Home.ctaSubtitle: Start a free trial in minutes. No card required.
Home.ctaImageAlt: A hand stacking coins into ascending stacks
Home.footerTagline: Manage your savings, shares and loans - anywhere, anytime.
